title: Look Beyond Morals
description: When assessing outcomes: - Pause: Ask yourself, "Could societal factors have contributed here?" - Contextualize: Consider external influences like environment, resources, or circumstances. - Avoid blame: Shift from moral judgment to understanding. Example: If someone misses a deadline, think about workload or system issues rather than assuming laziness.
